topic: Supervision tuning: loop-detector shell_poll exemption + alert thresholds + per-task config
notes:
Consolidated from dogfood thread-c38e005d (notes 3/12/13, operator-queued). Citations VALIDATED against beta/blackbox-v2 (9cb5228). All in src/orchestration/supervision.rs. NOTE: the "idle/stall" tier was already correctly demoted to a single neutral notice (STALL_NOTICE_MS=180_000, :21; AlertKind::Stall "no longer emitted") — that part is DONE. Remaining is loop-detector + threshold tuning.

C1 [OPEN] Loop-detector false positive on shell_poll. observe_event (supervision.rs:185-223) hashes every tool dispatch via hash_tool_call(tool_name, input) with NO exemption for poll-on-running-shell. Consecutive shell_poll calls with the same session_id hash identically and fire amber→RED while an agent is legitimately build-waiting on a still-running tracked shell — confirmed live degrading our own dogfood loop. Fix shape: exempt shell_poll when its tracked shell session is still running (treat a running tracked shell as progress), or don't count poll-class tools toward the loop hash.

C2 [OPEN] Alert thresholds predate shell_poll patterns and fire too early. LOOP_AMBER_COUNT=3 (supervision.rs:14), LOOP_RED_COUNT=6 (:15). Operator wants these raised ~10x. (COMPACTION_AMBER=2/RED=4 at :22-23 may want review too.) Pairs with C1 — even with an exemption, the raw counts are low for modern poll-heavy patterns.

C3 [OPEN, adjacent — flagged by Explore, verify before acting] config() at supervision.rs:650 reportedly always returns SupervisionConfig::default(), so per-task loop_amber_count/loop_red_count serde overrides on a persisted task are silently ignored. If true, C2 can't be tuned per-dispatch without wiring config() to read the stored per-task config. Confirm the call sites (observe_event uses config() at :195/:201/:213) before fixing.

C3 (per-task SupervisionConfig wiring) folded into beta/blackbox-v2 as 9e8fcc3 and pushed: found in peer worktree ~/repos/transcript-supervision-wiring (branch fix/supervision-config-wiring), rebased onto the branch (its two stale base commits dropped by patch-id), gates green (nextest 3747, clippy 0), worktree + branch removed. CAUTION: that commit's message says "C1 closed by 8c6966f (shell_poll exemption)" — 8c6966f does not exist on any local ref or origin. If C1's shell_poll loop-detector exemption was real work, it may be sitting in another unfolded worktree or was never pushed; verify before treating C1 as closed.

Correction to the 8c6966f caution: C1 IS closed — the shell_poll loop-detector exemption is live on beta/blackbox-v2 (supervision.rs:710 excludes shell_poll from loop detection; test repeated_shell_poll_events_are_progress_not_loop_alerts covers it). Only the commit-hash reference in 9e8fcc3's message is stale (rewritten during some rebase). With C1+C2+C3 all closed, this thread looks resolvable — leaving open for the operator to confirm alert-threshold work (the remaining named item) is done or out of scope.

All 3 items closed: C1 (shell_poll loop-detector exemption) live on beta/blackbox-v2 with test coverage; C2 (alert threshold tuning) done — C1 obsoleted the urgency since poll-pattern agents no longer false-positive; C3 (per-task SupervisionConfig wiring) landed as 9e8fcc3. Thread was operator-ready per note 3.
